notes: Built-in Wi-Fi. Any ESP32-WROOM-32 DevKit works. GPIO logic is 3.3 V.
pH interface: UART or I2C (I2C address 99). 1/2/3-point calibration and temperature compensation built in. Ships in UART mode; switch to I2C once.
ORP interface: UART or I2C (I2C address 98). -1020 to 1020 mV. Single-point calibration.
One for pH, one for ORP. Isolation stops the two probes in the same water from interfering. Female SMA probe jack.
pH 2-13, +/-0.1, 1-60 C, 1 m cable, SMA (BNC optional). Life about 12-18 months; recalibrate about every 3 months.
-1100 to 1100 mV, +/-1.1 mV, 1-60 C, 1 m cable, SMA (BNC optional).
